invariants.rationale: Used in a stream operation, must not be null.
partitioner.getPartition(...) is called, so partitioner cannot be null.
If the list is empty, its size must be zero; expresses equivalency between isEmpty and size.
record.getKey() and record.getCurrentLocation() are called, so all records should be non-null.
record.getKey() is called for every record, which implies keys must not be null.
